brief.headline: Switch from 100% advance to normal 30-day credit — that alone frees up ₹8.73 L of our cash — then close the ₹12.95 L/yr price gap to match Sayaji.

priceAsk.summary: Match the ₹66.48/KG we pay Sayaji Industries Limited for Dextrose
priceAsk.basis: We already buy the same material at ₹66.48/KG from Sayaji; market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48/KG sits in the fair band and we know it's achievable because we pay it today.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 100% advance to standard 30-day credit after delivery

brief.financialLeverage: They're a ₹1458.95 Cr company but keep only 2.3% as profit — very thin margins, so a brutal price fight could backfire. We're tiny to them: our ₹1.06 Cr is just 0.07% of their sales, so alone we have almost no pull. Their overall financial health scores D (33/100), meaning they're weaker than most peers. Because margins are paper-thin and we're small, lead with payment terms (which costs them nothing and saves us real cash), then use the credible alternates and our existing ₹66.48/KG benchmark to justify the price move — don't squeeze so hard they walk or stumble.

evidence.point: We pay them ₹70.80/KG; we pay Sayaji ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose
Closing that gap saves us ₹12.95 L every year
Right now we pay them 100% in advance — the worst terms we give anyone
evidence.figure: Advance 100%(with tax)Against Proforma Invoice, areWorstTerms: true

evidence.point: Moving to 30-day credit frees up ₹8.73 L of our cash
We are 0.07% of their ₹1458.95 Cr revenue — a very small customer
They keep only 2.3% profit on every rupee sold, so margins are razor-thin

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health score B (62/100) — established dextrose supplier, stronger financials than Sukhjit, a credible drop-in alternate.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (starch, dextrose), ₹821.13 Cr revenue, health C (53/100) — growing capacity, another direct alternate.

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global starch major, ₹2898.05 Cr revenue — pharma-grade dextrose, very reliable, premium quality systems (though health score D (28/100) so verify stability before RFQ).

risks: We're only 0.07% of their sales, so they may ignore us unless we bundle more volume or commit longer term.
Margins at 2.3% mean pushing price too hard could force them to walk or cut quality — prioritise payment terms first.
Their financial health is D (33/100), weaker than peers, so watch for any supply hiccups and line up a second source now.
We pay 100% advance today — any move to credit will need their finance sign-off; be ready to phase it (e.g. start at 15 days, then 30).
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to align your pricing to the ₹66.48/KG we already pay Sayaji for Dextrose and move from advance payment to standard 30-day terms — that's fair to both sides and frees up working cash for us.
